about.title: How to play
about.intro: One shared phone, a circle of friends, and a deck with a few surprises.
about.step1: Add at least two players, choose who's joining, and set the order. Saved players stay on this device for next time.
about.step2: Read the current player's card aloud, then tap Done to move on. For a temporary rule, choose a player if asked; Activate & next player saves the rule and moves on together. Everyone getting a turn completes one circle.
about.step3: Temporary rules apply to a named player or everyone and expire after the shown number of turns or circles. Permanent house rules always apply to everyone until the game ends.
about.step4: Every two completed circles, the next player writes a permanent house rule for everyone. After each player has written one, these prompts stop.
about.note: No scores, no pressure, and no one has to drink. Agree on boundaries together; any drink or no drink works.
about.storage: Players, photos, custom cards, and your current game are stored in this browser. Clearing browser data removes them. Export a backup from the card library. Private browsing may not keep saves after you close it.
